p.x: Paul Greets the Saints in Rome

w.t: I might have a prosperous journey
that I may be comforted together
by the things that are made
the things that are more excellent

p.x: Death in Adam, Life in Christ

w.t: of him that was to come

p.x: Dead to Sin, Alive to God

w.t: shall lay any thing to the charge
of them that preach the gospel
the olive tree which is wild

p.x: Christ the Servant of Jews and Gentiles
Paul the Minister to the Gentiles

w.t: to be brought on my way
to him that is of power
